|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/theywillbenomatchforyou.html</ref>

For players who thought that [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe{{!}}Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] would be a dead deck after [[Coruscant (Dark) (Coruscant){{!}}Coruscant]] and the armada of Jedi were released, they are dead wrong. This card lets a Dark Side player be totally flexible when dueling and hunting down Jedi. [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] is still the man, but [[Maul]] can play a crucial backup role especially if [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] is avoiding [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] or forces Imperials to take him in as a prisoner (via There Is Still Good In Him). [[Maul]] is no Imperial so he will take [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] head on. And while [[Maul]] has a lightsaber, he gets an extra bonus for dueling. Only fair since you have used up one of your effects if you are using [[Prepared Defenses]].

Combo:

[[Maul]] steps up to the plate, grabs his bat and takes a swing at a Jedi. There's going to be plenty of dueling now.
